Name: PIF A House Inside My House - Full Farmhouse Interior Rooms
Author: glymr
Description:
A set of ten PIF rooms based on the vanilla farmhouse and farm buildings:

[list=1]
[*]the starter farmhouse[/*]
[*]the 1st upgrade[/*]
[*]the 1st upgrade without a kitchen[/*]
[*]the 2nd upgrade[/*]
[*]the 2nd upgrade without a kitchen[/*]
[*]3rd upgrade fully renovated[/*]
[*]3rd upgrade fully renovated without a kitchen[/*]
[*]the cellar[/*]
[*]small shed interior[/*]
[*]big shed interior[/*]
[/list]
Each type can be chosen from the beginning of the game and will not change, even if you upgrade the farmhouse (you can have a Level 0 Farmhouse and a Level 3 PIF Farmhouse Room, for example, or a Level 3 Farmhouse with a Level 0 PIF Farmhouse room for extra space). Beds and mini-fridges can be placed in all rooms.

Sleeping in PIF rooms now seems to work! But for now I'm leaving in a built-in special secret warp, just in case.
[spoiler]If you get trapped in one of my PIF Farmhouses, click on the vertical piece on the left side of the doorway in any of these Farmhouse rooms and you should be warped to just outside your farmhouse door. (If you're using a custom farm map or if you've moved your farmhouse, you may still end up trapped somewhere, so be sure to have NoClip installed  or if you get truly stuck type:
[code]debug wh[/code]directly into the black SMAPI console window and hit enter). This secret warp was only meant as a stop-gap until PIF is updated to allow sleeping in PIF rooms, so I will remove it in a future version of this mod unless I get reports that people are still getting trapped.[/spoiler]
You may see some yellow text regarding this warp in SMAPI; this is harmless and I can't do anything about it until I remove the warp. 

The kitchens work. A refrigerator is included (it can be re-skinned with any Alternative Textures that works with mini-fridges). Watering cans can be filled from the sink. You should also be able to place additional mini-fridges and beds here.

All rooms can be decorated (floors and walls). I've added more decorating flexibility into the renovated houses than the Vanilla versions by re-arranging the wallpaper and floorpaper layout.

NPCs will not enter these rooms, so feel free to decorate and enjoy your extra house without worrying that your spouse will randomly change the wallpaper or add furniture. These extra houses are great if you just want more space, love to decorate, or are playing multiplayer and don't want to have to invest in upgrading multiple cabins.

If you have any questions or run into any problems, PLEASE let me know. <3 I can't fix something if I don't know it's broken.

If you like this mod, it would make me very happy if you would endorse it. <3  Thank you!
